metadata.title: Second homology of some quandles
metadata.abstract: We derive formulas from Eisemann's formula for the second quandle homology of quandles. We prove that for a finite injective quandle $Q$, the second quandle homology $H_2(Q)$ can be computed in a representation group of $Q$, which is a finite quotient of the enveloping group of $Q$, by giving a formula for that. We use this to compute $H_2(Q)$ for $Q$ the subquandle of $k$-cycles of $S_n$ and $Q$ the quandle corresponding to the conjugacy class of a diagonalizable element of $SL(n,q)$, with some exceptions. For $G$ a finite group with trivial Bogomolov multiplier, as many classical groups, simple groups and (with exceptions) quasi-simple groups, we derive a formula for $H_2(Conj(G))$ that can be computed in $G$ alone. The formula relies on conjugacy classes of $G$, centralizers in $G$ of representative of such classes and the derived group of $G$. If $G$ is moreover perfect this formula can be related to the first Hochschild homology of the group ring $\mathbb{Z}[G]$. As an application, we compute $H_2(Q)$ for $Q$ the conjugacy quandle of $GL(2,q)$ for $q\neq 2,3$.
